Scenario 1 introduces 3 CCF markings. In this forest a paint mark records a management decision on the tree itself: | • Orange vertical stripes — Rack / machine-path removal | • Red — Fell | • Blue — Crop Tree / future timber |  | Orange vertical stripes identify rack entrance trees associated with machine-path removal in Scenario 1. One spray paints vertical stripes on four sides of the entrance tree. |  | The game asks you to mark the rack entrance tree as a teaching action. Real marking practice may mark additional trees along a route. |  | After Confirm Rack Plan, walk to a rack entrance and press P to equip the spray marker. Aim at the first designated rack-removal tree at the headland-side rack entrance, within 3.5 m, and left-click; P stows the marker. A tree carries only one of these marks: the spray will not mark a Fell or Crop Tree, and X or C cannot change an orange mark. Marking cuts nothing: the rack's removal work still needs approval in the Work Plan [Tab].
